prompt:
Build a closed-loop nonlinear jacketed continuous stirred-tank reactor for a first-order exothermic reaction. The dynamic plant must contain coupled mass and energy balances for reactant concentration, reactor temperature, jacket temperature, and liquid hold-up. Maintain reactor temperature by manipulating the real coolant-flow path and maintain liquid level by manipulating the real outlet-flow path. Both regulated paths must use measured plant feedback and dynamic actuation; prescribed output trajectories, an open-loop lookup, or unrelated controllers are not sufficient.

Read reactor_temperature_setpoint_K, liquid_level_setpoint_m, feed_flow_kg_s, feed_concentration_kmol_m3, feed_temperature_K, coolant_inlet_temperature_K, disturbance_start_s, feed_flow_ramp_kg_s2, feed_concentration_ramp_kmol_m3_s, feed_temperature_ramp_K_s, coolant_inlet_temperature_ramp_K_s, catalyst_decay_rate_s_inverse, and heat_transfer_decay_rate_s_inverse from the MATLAB base workspace and support the declared ranges. Before disturbance_start_s, use the four declared feed and coolant inlet values. Afterwards, add each declared ramp slope multiplied by elapsed time since disturbance_start_s to its corresponding physical inlet. Catalyst activity and the effective heat-transfer factor must each equal one before disturbance_start_s and then decay as exp(-rate*(t-disturbance_start_s)). Apply these quantities to the real reaction and jacket heat-transfer paths.

The scalar inputs have these ranges and units: reactor_temperature_setpoint_K [394, 404] K; liquid_level_setpoint_m [0.45, 0.55] m; feed_flow_kg_s [8, 12] kg/s; feed_concentration_kmol_m3 [0.8, 1.2] kmol/m^3; feed_temperature_K [330, 370] K; coolant_inlet_temperature_K [285, 320] K; disturbance_start_s [150, 350] s; feed_flow_ramp_kg_s2 [-0.004, 0.004] kg/s^2; feed_concentration_ramp_kmol_m3_s [-0.0005, 0.0005] kmol/m^3/s; feed_temperature_ramp_K_s [-0.04, 0.04] K/s; coolant_inlet_temperature_ramp_K_s [-0.04, 0.04] K/s; catalyst_decay_rate_s_inverse [0, 0.0005] 1/s; and heat_transfer_decay_rate_s_inverse [0, 0.0008] 1/s.

Log complete-run Timeseries named reactor_state, flow_state, and control_state on one shared, strictly increasing time axis covering the complete simulation. reactor_state has four channels [liquid level in m, reactant concentration in kmol/m^3, reactor temperature in K, jacket temperature in K]. flow_state has six channels [feed flow in kg/s, outlet flow in kg/s, coolant flow in kg/s, feed concentration in kmol/m^3, feed temperature in K, coolant inlet temperature in K]. control_state has six channels [reactor-temperature setpoint in K, liquid-level setpoint in m, temperature error in K, level error in m, catalyst activity, effective heat-transfer factor]. The logged states and flows must come from the connected causal simulation.

Save the completed model as cand_XTHERM11.slx in the submission directory and keep the latest usable state saved there throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XTHERM11.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
